description: Welcome to Team TECH AND SPACE! We are tackling the "Abandoned but not Forgotten" challenge to bring the stories of NASA’s discarded equipment on the Moon and Mars to life. Combining AI/ML, data analysis, and visualization, we aim to turn space history into an engaging experience. We are looking for passionate teammates skilled in coding, data science, storytelling, and planetary science (English/Hindi speakers) to join our Chennai squad. Let’s build something stellar together!

details:
Forgotten Footprints: Moon & Mars

Forgotten Footprints: Moon & Mars is an interactive digital storytelling platform that explores human-made equipment and spacecraft components left behind on the Moon and Mars during space exploration missions.

The project aims to preserve and showcase the history of space exploration by helping users discover forgotten artifacts, understand their mission purposes, explore their locations, and learn about their scientific and historical significance.

Our platform provides interactive Moon and Mars exploration, planetary maps, artifact information, mission timelines, visual storytelling, and an AI-powered Space History Assistant. Users can search for artifacts, explore missions, and understand why certain equipment remained on planetary surfaces after missions.

The project uses NASA's publicly available resources and mission information to present space exploration history in an engaging and educational way. It also highlights planetary protection, potential environmental concerns, and the importance of sustainable future space exploration.

Technologies Used:

  • Frontend: React.js, Vite, JavaScript, Tailwind CSS
  • Backend: Python, FastAPI
  • Database: MongoDB / JSON
  • Visualization: Interactive maps and charts
  • Data Sources: NASA Open APIs and NASA Image and Video Library

Innovation and Creativity:

Our project transforms overlooked space mission equipment into interactive digital stories. Instead of simply displaying historical information, it connects artifacts with their missions, purposes, locations, and scientific contributions through an engaging exploration experience.

Intended Impact:

The platform aims to increase public awareness of space exploration history, promote scientific curiosity, educate users about planetary protection, and encourage responsible exploration of the Moon and Mars.
